Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1240409. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240409'. Return rows sorted by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
